sections.title: Introduction
sections.extract: \setcounter{equation}{0} Analogs of the Racah-Wigner $6j$-symbols coming from the study of a non-compact quantum group have been introduced in \cite{PT1}. The quantum group in question is related to $\CU_q(\fsl(2,\BR))$ and is often referred to as the modular double of $\CU_q(\fsl(2,\BR))$.
